meta.title: The Extra Mango
meta.textType: story: an honest choice at the market

paragraphs: On Thursday, July thirtieth, Mia, Leo, and May went to the market after school. It was four o'clock, and the market was busy. Many people walked between the stalls. The Explorers needed fruit for their open evening the next day. Before they left school, Teacher Kim gave May one hundred baht. May held the money in her hand and walked carefully. A woman in a green apron sold mangoes at a stall. Her mangoes were big and yellow, and they were fresh and cheap. Mia took photos of the colorful fruit stalls for the blog. A sign said, "FRESH MANGOES: five for one hundred baht."

"Five mangoes, please," said May. May gave the money to the woman. The price was easy to read, so May knew how much to pay. The woman put the mangoes in a bag, and she was very fast. Mia and Leo waited next to May. Before they left the stall, Leo counted the mangoes. "Six! We paid for five," said Leo. He stopped and looked at the sign again. It said five, and the bag had six. Leo did not want to take something that was not his.
"Have you ever had an extra mango before, Leo?" asked May. "No, never," said Leo. "It is not our mango." "Are you sure?" asked Mia. "Yes, I'm sure," said Leo. "Let's hurry back to the stall."

They ran back to the stall, and the woman was still there. "Excuse me," said Leo. "Your bag has six mangoes, but we paid for five." The woman laughed. "You are honest customers," she said. After Leo gave back the extra mango, she cut it into three pieces. She gave each child a piece of sweet mango. The mango was delicious. "Thank you!" said May. The children carried five mangoes back to school. Leo smiled all the way back.
text.summary: Mia, Leo, and May buy mangoes at the market. Leo counts six mangoes, but they paid for five. They go back, and the seller gives them a piece of sweet mango.
